documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Voting Results Along With Scrutiniser''s Report Of The 44Th Annual General Meeting Held On 18Th September, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Vidya Wires reported strong operational and financial performance for FY26, driven by robust demand in the power and transmission sector and a successful IPO in December 2025. Management highlighted the commencement of manufacturing at their new ALCU Industries facility on February 7, 2026, which introduces specialized higher-margin product categories such as aluminium paper-covered conductors, enamelled wires, and CTC. The company is actively scaling up capacity towards 35,000 to 36,000 metric tons by Diwali 2026 and aims to maintain disciplined procurement and back-to-back hedging to insulate against base metal volatility. Vidya Wires Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for the period ended December 31, 2025, with nine-month revenue from operations reaching ₹12,408.58 million and PAT at ₹380.43 million. Management highlighted ongoing expansion plans to increase production capacity from 19,680 MT to 37,680 MT and scale up market share to 11.3%, alongside broadening the product portfolio.

guidance.claim: Management estimates capacity utilization of the new facility to be around 55% to 60% next year.
guidance.quote: So, the next year we see that new capacity will come up and we are looking around 55% to 60% of that capacity should be able to utilize.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry research indicates a rebound in India's power demand growth to the 5% to 5.5% range.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry research indicates a rebound in India's power demand growth to 5% to 5.5% range, driven by data centers, industrial consumption and the ongoing energy transition.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that power and transmission segments have performed well.
demand_outlook.quote: So of course the power and transmission segment which includes transformers, so that has really performed well.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian winding and conductivity products market stands at approximately 3.43 lakh metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian winding and conductivity products market stands at approximately 3.43 lakh metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: India's power generation capacity is expected to more than double from 442 gigawatt in 2024 to approximately 900 gigawatt by 2032.
demand_outlook.quote: Today, the generation capacity is expected to more than double from 442 gigawatt in 2024 to approximately 900 gigawatt by 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: The transmission sector is anticipated to attract investments of approximately Rs. 9.16 trillion.
demand_outlook.quote: The transmission sector alone is anticipated to attract investments of approximately Rs.9.16 trillion.

demand_outlook.claim: Solar capacity is expected to reach 365 gigawatt by FY2032 growing at a 14.5% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: Solar capacity is expected to reach 365 gigawatt by FY2032 growing at a 14.5% CAGR.

demand_outlook.claim: The wire and cable market is projected to grow from US $17.7 billion to US $27.8 billion by 2028 at a 9.5% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: The wire and cable market is projected to grow from US $17.7 billion to US $27.8 billion by 2028 at a 9.5% CAGR.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commenced manufacturing at the new ALCU plant on February 7th, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: While we have commenced manufacturing on February 7th, 2026, I want to emphasize that we are currently in a phased ramp-up period.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects total capacity to reach close to 35,000 to 36,000 metric tons by Diwali.
capex_expansion.quote: So we will be close to -- by Diwali we will be close to 35,00, 36,000 metric tons of capacity, which was planned.

capex_expansion.claim: The company introduced several new specialized product categories including aluminium paper-covered conductors and copper bus bars.
capex_expansion.quote: With this facility now operational, we have successfully introduced several new specialized product categories, which includes aluminium paper-covered conductors, aluminium enamelled wires and strips, PV round ribbon, multi-paper covered copper conductors and copper bus bars.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing capacity is nearly doubling from 19,680 metric tons per annum to 37,680 metric tons per annum through the new facility Narsanda via subsidiary ALCU Industries.
capex_expansion.quote: We are nearly doubling our manufacturing capacity from 19680 metric tons per annum to 37680 metric tons per annum through our new facility Narsanda via our subsidiary called as ALCU Industries.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of IPO proceeds, Rs. 140 Crores is allocated for capital expenditure at ALCU Industries.
capex_expansion.quote: On IPO proceeds, as committed we are prudently deploying the fresh issue funds our IPO raised Rs.274 Crores, Rs. 140 Crores is allocated for capital expenditure at ALCU Industries; this will nearly double our capacity to 37,680 metric tons and enable new product lines.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil construction for the new facility is 75% to 80% complete and operations will start in the last quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: So we have probably completed more than 75% to 80 % of our construction and we believe in the last quarter, we will start our operations very soon.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 reached 857.8 million with a margin of 4.66, representing a 35 basis points year-over-year improvement.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA reached 857.8 million with a margin of 4.66, an increase of 35 basis points year-over-year improvement.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains a strict back-to-back hedging policy for copper and aluminium procurement to protect margins.
margins_costs.quote: To protect our margins, we have continued our strict back-to-back hedging policy for copper and aluminium procurement.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY2026 EBITDA without other income grew by 19% to Rs. 34 Crores, with EBITDA margin increasing by 50 basis points to 4.3%.
margins_costs.quote: H1 FY2026 EBITDA without other income grew by 19% to Rs. 34 Crores. The EBITDA margin increased to 4.3% an improvement of 50 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: PAT grew nearly 30% to Rs. 23 Crores with PAT margin increasing to 2.8%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT grew nearly 30% to Rs. 23 Crores with a PAT margin increase to 2.8% while EPS grew 29% to Rs.1.41.

margins_costs.claim: The company operates a completely back-to-back pricing model where LME price increases are passed on 100% to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Basically, we have a completely back to back pricing model. So about the pricing pass on, it would be 100% whatever price increase in the LME is there will be passed on to the customer.

orders_capacity.claim: The new ALCU plant achieved approximately 800 metric tons of volume after starting in mid-February.
orders_capacity.quote: So basically, in February mid only, I mean the first week only we have started and we have done some 800 metric tons approximately volume from ALCU Industries.

orders_capacity.claim: Vidya Wires is the fourth largest player in the Indian winding and conductivity product industry with a 5.7% market share.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, Vidya Wires is the fourth largest player in the Indian winding and conductivity product industry with a 5.7% market share.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is on an average around 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, currently our capacity is in like on an average 90% or so we are already utilizing it

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilized INR100 crores from IPO proceeds to repay working capital borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to a lean balance sheet, we have utilized INR100 crores to repay our working capital borrowings, successfully reducing our interest burden and strengthening our credit profile.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs 1,000 million is allocated for loan repayment or prepayment to reduce the interest burden.
capital_allocation.quote: ₹1,000 million allocated for loan repayment/prepayment to reduce interest burden.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 100 Crores from IPO proceeds is allocated for the repayment of borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs.100 Crores is for repayment of borrowings. This will reduce leverage, lower finance cost and improve our debt equity ratio.

capital_allocation.claim: The IPO raised Rs. 274 Crores in fresh issue funds.
capital_allocation.quote: our IPO raised Rs.274 Crores, Rs. 140 Crores is allocated for capital expenditure at ALCU Industries; this will nearly double our capacity to 37,680 metric tons and enable new product lines.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching 100% planned capacity operations at ALCU by September, October, or before Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: and the remaining 8, 000 to 9,000 tons or so will be added over a period of around September or October or before Diwali we are expecting to operate at 100% capacity planned in ALCU.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a long-term business mix of 75% domestic and 25% export.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we are definitely targeting the international market and our target is that we should have a balance of 75% domestic and 25% export.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reduce debtor days from 41 days down to around 35 days.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, we are at 41 days of debtors as of now, and we can definitely bring it down to around 35 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects FY27 to be the first full year realizing the consolidated benefits of expanded capacity.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead to the financial year 2026-27, the outlook for our sector is increasingly positive.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reduce and keep receivable days up to 30 days and inventory days up to 20 days.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, we will be trying to keep receivable days up to 30 days and basically inventory days up to 20 days.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
